domain: Subtracting fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification to lowest terms

skills.name: Normalize operands
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number or nonstandard mixed number into a subtraction-ready form before carrying out subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus a zero fraction, such as 3 = 3 + 0/5.
Tag when a mixed number with an improper fractional part is converted to an equivalent standard mixed number.
Tag when the solver explicitly restructures an operand before subtraction so whole and fractional parts can be handled consistently.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag equivalent-fraction conversion whose purpose is to create a common denominator; that belongs to common denominator conversion.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping that occurs after subtraction has begun.
Do not tag final recombination of whole and fractional results into the answer.

skills.name: Common denominator conversion
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and rewrite one or both fractional parts as equivalent fractions with that denominator before subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solver finds an LCD or other common denominator for unlike denominators.
Tag when one or both fractions are converted to equivalent fractions with the same denominator.
Tag when mixed-number fraction parts are rewritten to matching denominators before subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag rewriting a whole number as a whole plus 0/n unless the step's main purpose is denominator alignment and the denominator is explicitly chosen for that reason.
Do not tag subtraction of numerators after denominators are already aligned.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract whole-number parts and/or fractional parts once the operands are already in compatible form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a shared denominator.
Tag when whole parts of mixed numbers or whole-minus-whole components are subtracted.
Tag when the solver subtracts whole and fraction parts separately after setup is complete, even if the fractional result is initially zero or negative.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag finding a common denominator or converting to equivalent fractions.
Do not tag the regrouping step that fixes a negative fractional result; that belongs to borrowing across parts.
Do not tag simplification or final assembly of the answer.

skills.name: Borrow across parts
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as an equivalent fraction and adjust the whole part when the fractional part of the minuend is too small to subtract directly.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solver borrows 1 from the whole part to continue subtraction.
Tag when 1 whole is rewritten as d/d and added to the fractional part.
Tag when regrouping changes an initially negative fractional difference into a subtractable positive fraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag initial rewriting of a whole number as a whole plus 0/d before subtraction.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number.
Do not tag straightforward subtraction cases where no regrouping is needed.

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce the resulting fraction to lowest terms or rewrite a zero-valued fraction as 0 after subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is reduced by a common factor after subtraction.
Tag when a result such as 0/n is rewritten as 0.
Tag when the step explicitly performs simplification before the final answer is stated.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag final recombination of whole and fractional parts unless an actual reduction or zero-fraction simplification occurs in that step.
Do not tag operand normalization before subtraction.

skills.name: Compose final form
skills.definition: Combine the computed whole-number and fractional parts into the final mixed number, fraction, or integer answer.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when separate whole and fraction results are recombined into one final number.
Tag when a zero whole part is omitted to present a proper fraction.
Tag when a whole part is combined with a zero fraction to present an integer.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag intermediate subtraction of whole or fraction parts.
Do not tag simplification alone unless the step also explicitly assembles the final form.
Do not tag operand rewriting before subtraction.
